title: MSCS Student
enBio: **Research Interests**: Robot Learning, Planning and Control. Especially interested in dextrous manipulation.
👋 Hi, I'm currently a master student studying at Georgia Tech. Before coming to Atlanta, I earned a bachelor's degree from Tsinghua University in Beijing.

For my undergraduate thesis, I worked under [Professor Xiang Li](https://sites.google.com/view/homepageoflixiang/home)'s supervision, focusing on multi-agent RL. In summer 2024, I visited [Professor Jiachen Li](https://jiachenli94.github.io/)'s lab at UC Riverside and participated in autonomous driving projects.
Beyond academic experiences, I completed an internship at [Booster Robotics](https://www.booster.tech/) in 2025, where I worked on humanoid trajectory synthesis and RL-based locomotion.
